name: GuideCompare
description: Discover, compare, and find travel activities & tours in Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok directly from Claude. GuideCompare searches thousands of tours, attractions, food experiences, and day trips across major booking platforms — Viator, GetYourGuide, Klook, and more — and returns live prices, durations, and traveller ratings side by side. Plan full itineraries that mix famous landmarks with bookable activities, filter by budget, duration, or accessibility, and book at partner websites. No account or login required — just ask Claude what to do, and compare your options instantly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GuideCompare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GuideCompare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.guidecompare.com/v1/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GuideCompare MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GuideCompare provides these MCP tools: search_activities, get_activity, list_pois, and list_cities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GuideCompare?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GuideCompare in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
GuideCompare does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
GuideCompare is developed by GuideCompare. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
